name: Page of Swords
meaning_for_today: Today brings curiosity, mental activity, and new ideas. It is a good time to learn, observe carefully, and stay alert to new information or unexpected news.
card_advice: Stay curious but avoid jumping to conclusions. Think before speaking or acting, and use your mental energy to explore rather than judge too quickly.

upright.short: Curiosity, vigilance, new ideas, and mental energy.
upright.general: The Page of Swords represents intellectual curiosity, alertness, and a thirst for knowledge. It often indicates new ideas, learning opportunities, or the beginning of a mental or communication-based journey. This card encourages observation, questioning, and gathering information before taking action.
upright.in_love: In love, it can indicate curiosity about a new relationship or cautious communication between partners. It may also suggest overthinking or analyzing emotions instead of expressing them freely.
upright.in_situation: In situations, it points to gathering information, staying alert, and being ready for new developments. It is important to remain observant and avoid impulsive judgments.

reversed.short: Gossip, misinformation, impatience, and scattered thinking.
reversed.general: Reversed, the Page of Swords can indicate poor communication, misinformation, or mental restlessness. It may suggest acting without full understanding or being overly suspicious and reactive.
reversed.in_love: In relationships, it can point to miscommunication, gossip, or distrust. One may be overly analytical or emotionally immature in expressing feelings.
reversed.in_situation: In situations, it warns of misunderstandings, lack of preparation, or jumping to conclusions without enough facts.
